description: KDE KCM profile management — Qt Quick test scenarios
driver: Qt Quick QML engine with QAccessible / Qt Test (QSignalSpy) and the Rust p2p fake bus

scenarios.name: rename_profile
validation: empty name rejected with inline error
duplicate name rejected (DuplicateName from manager)
success refreshes list via ProfileChanged signal
list state persists after daemon restart
a11y: confirm button has Accessible.role Button and i18n name

scenarios.name: enable_disable
steps: toggle enabled switch on profile card
validation: EnableProfile call round-trips; switch state matches store after refresh
state persists after daemon restart
disabled profile does not match on verify (daemon-side; KCM only reflects state)
a11y: Accessible.name includes profile name via i18n interpolation

scenarios.name: delete_profile
validation: confirmation dialog shown with profile name
profile removed after confirm
cancel preserves profile
DeleteProfile on cross-uid target triggers polkit
a11y: dialog has Accessible.name with i18n text
confirm button has destructive styling and Accessible.role Button

scenarios.name: merge_profiles
validation: self-merge prevented (source == destination rejected client-side and server-side)
merge writes combined templates to destination via store transaction
source profile removed after successful merge
merge rollback on store error preserves both profiles
a11y: merge dialog lists both profiles by name with Accessible.role StaticText

scenarios.name: replace_profile
validation: old profile preserved until replacement CommitProfile succeeds
confirmation required before starting replacement capture
on replacement success, old templates overwritten atomically
cancel mid-replacement preserves old profile
a11y: replace warning has Accessible.role Alert with i18n name including profile name
confirm and cancel buttons have Accessible.role Button

scenarios.name: reduced_protection_warning_r9
steps: daemon reports always_on_emitter status (R9 reduced-protection fixture)
full-protection fixture: daemon reports normal emitter
validation: R9 fixture: warning banner shown with i18n text explaining always-on emitter risk
full-protection fixture: banner NOT shown
banner presence driven by StatusReport always_on_emitter field, not a heuristic
a11y: Accessible.name set to i18n('Reduced protection: emitter does not turn off')
banner is keyboard reachable and live-announced

scenarios.name: stale_state
steps: profile deleted by another client (or daemon restart)
validation: stale profile removed from list after refresh
no crash, no dangling QML references
late async replies dropped via generation counter mismatch
a11y: list update announced via Accessible.role List with live region

scenarios.name: polkit_denied
steps: request destructive action (delete / merge / replace) on cross-uid target
validation: manager returns PermissionDenied
KCM shows error message with reason
profile list unchanged (rollback)
no store mutation occurred

privacy: No scores, thresholds, embeddings, frames, PAD detail, or biometric images in any QML element; match confidence shown as coarse non-numeric buckets

withheld.kcmshell6_runtime_load: kcmshell6 / plasma-systemsettings not installed; runtime QML loading in a real Plasma session is the next HIL step
withheld.screen_reader_orca: no orca / no running Plasma session; structural a11y roles asserted by source audit
